notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor 271f0a31) with the published fast-agent-mcp[ptc] 0.10.48 wheel, programmatic tool calling on (code-only: tools behind one execute_python tool); GPT-6.1 Terra (medium reasoning) through the OpenAI Responses API with an API key, flex service tier. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply.

Three infrastructure failures (two agent setup timeouts, one sandbox error) were rerun as replacements, all of which passed. The originals are kept as evidence; the run as first launched scored 382/445.
Ten trials ended with AgentSafetyRefusalError (vulnerable-secret ×5, break-filter-js-from-html ×5) and score 0; model outcomes, not rerun.

Cost is Harbor's recorded cost at the cohort's configured OpenAI flex rates (card-packs pricing catalog 2026-10-26.1, rules gpt-6.1-terra-flex-short / -long: $0.50 / $0.025 / $0.625 / $2.50 per million input / cached / cache-write / output tokens; $1 / $0.05 / $1.25 / $3.75 above 272k context). Flex is an optional OpenAI service tier at exactly half the standard rates on every band, so the same usage at standard rates costs twice as much. Eight trials have model calls that reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound.
